growth.area.discipline.label: Discipline
growth.area.discipline.blurb: Follow through on what you say you will do.
growth.area.discipline.goal: What would being more disciplined look like for you? Name one thing you would be doing differently.
growth.area.discipline.hint: For example: I start strong, then stop after a few days.
growth.area.procrastination.label: Beating procrastination
growth.area.procrastination.blurb: Stop putting off the things that matter.
growth.area.procrastination.goal: What are you putting off right now that you most want to get moving on?
growth.area.procrastination.hint: For example: I scroll on my phone, or the task feels too big to start.
growth.area.habits.label: Building better habits
growth.area.habits.blurb: Start a good habit, or let go of one that holds you back.
growth.area.habits.goal: Which habit do you want to build, or which one do you want to break?
growth.area.habits.hint: For example: I forget, or I am too tired in the evening.
growth.area.time.label: Time management and productivity
growth.area.time.blurb: Get the important things done without burning out.
growth.area.time.goal: Where does your time go that you wish it did not? What would a good day look like?
growth.area.time.hint: For example: meetings, too many tasks at once, no plan for the day.
growth.area.goals.label: Goal setting
growth.area.goals.blurb: Turn something you want into steps you can take.
growth.area.goals.goal: What is one goal you want to make real progress on in the next 30 days?
growth.area.goals.hint: For example: I do not know where to start, or I lose motivation.
growth.area.confidence.label: Becoming more confident
growth.area.confidence.blurb: Trust yourself more and speak up for yourself.
growth.area.confidence.goal: Where in your life do you most want to feel more confident?
growth.area.confidence.hint: For example: I worry what people think, or I talk myself down.
growth.area.growth.label: Personal growth
growth.area.growth.blurb: Become more of the person you want to be.
growth.area.growth.goal: What part of yourself do you most want to grow or improve right now?
growth.area.growth.hint: For example: old patterns, busy life, not sure what to change first.
growth.q.obstacle: What usually gets in the way?
growth.q.time: How much time can you give this on most days?
growth.q.life: Is anything going on in your life that the plan should work around?
growth.q.life_hint: For example: exams, a new job, young children, night shifts.
growth.q.success: Thirty days from now, how will you know it worked?

s.home.title: Kounselia — Someone to Talk To, Anytime
s.home.meta_desc: Kounselia gives you a private space to talk through what you're carrying. Real conversations with specialist counselors, available anytime, anywhere.
s.home.hero_p: Sometimes the hardest part is finding a safe place to say what you're actually feeling. Kounselia gives you that space, anytime you need it.
s.home.feels_body: Think of it like walking into a private clinic and being connected with the right specialist for what you are going through. Not a general assistant. A real conversation with someone who understands your specific situation.
s.home.feels1_body: Each counselor is built around one area. You are not talking to a generic tool. You are talking to someone who has spent everything on understanding exactly what you are going through.
s.home.feels2_body: Every time you come back, your counselor already knows where you are. No starting over. No repeating yourself. The conversation picks up like a good therapist who reviewed your notes before you arrived.
s.home.feels3_title: Built with your safety in mind
s.home.feels3_body: If things get serious, you will never be left alone. The platform is designed to recognise distress and connect you with real human support when you need it most.
s.home.counselors_title: Who would you like to talk to?
s.home.counselors_sub: No account needed. Just pick the person who feels right for what you are carrying today.
s.home.c_serena_desc: Serena is the person you talk to when the feeling is hard to name. She never rushes. She never judges. She just listens and helps you find your way through.
s.home.c_marcus_desc: Marcus is for the person standing at a crossroads. If your career no longer feels right or you are searching for what your work is supposed to mean, he will help you think it through clearly.
s.home.c_noa_desc: Noa is for the person who knows something needs to change but cannot quite name what. She helps you look at the patterns, the inherited beliefs, and the version of yourself that is trying to emerge.
s.home.c_eli_desc: Eli is for when your relationships are hurting. Whether it is a pattern you keep repeating, a conversation you keep avoiding, or love that is causing more pain than joy, Eli helps you see it clearly.
s.home.c_dr_lena_desc: Dr. Lena is for those carrying the weight of things that happened in the past. She moves at your pace, never pushes, and understands that healing from trauma takes its own kind of time.
s.home.c_james_desc: James is for men who were never given real space to talk. No performance, no judgement, no pressure to have it together. Just an honest conversation with someone who gets it.
s.home.c_theo_desc: Theo is for anyone who has lost something that mattered. A person, a relationship, a version of your life you had imagined. He holds space for grief with no timeline and no rush to feel better.
s.home.c_priya_desc: Priya is for the person who has been running on empty for too long. If you are exhausted in a way that sleep does not fix and meaning has drained out of things that used to matter, talk to Priya.
s.home.guest_note: No account needed to start. {link} to save your sessions and return anytime.
s.home.pros_title: When you want a person in the room
s.home.pros_p: Our AI counselors are there any time. When you're ready for more, book a private video session with a licensed psychologist, counsellor or therapist — every one verified by our team.
s.home.pros_e1_body: We check every professional's credentials with the body that issued them.
s.home.pros_e2_body: Book a time that suits you and meet from your dashboard.
s.home.pros_e3_body: Rated by clients after real sessions — anonymously.
s.home.pros_join: Are you a professional? Join us
s.home.voice1_quote: I have known for two years that I needed to talk to someone. The cost, the waiting, the fear of being judged kept stopping me. This was the first time I actually said what I have been carrying.
s.home.voice2_quote: Marcus asked me one question that completely changed how I see my career. I have been stuck in the wrong conversation with myself for three years.
s.home.voice3_quote: I did not expect to cry. James did not make me feel like something was wrong with me. He just listened and asked the right things.
s.home.why_title: Most people who need support never get it
s.home.why_body: Not because they do not want help. But because therapy is expensive, waiting lists are long, and for many people around the world, {strong} We built Kounselia because we believe that should change.
s.home.why_body_strong: a trained professional is simply not accessible.
s.home.why_stat1: People living with a mental health condition worldwide
s.home.why_stat2: In lower income countries receive no support at all
s.home.pillar1_body: Every counselor conversation is built around established therapeutic frameworks including CBT, motivational interviewing, and trauma informed care.
s.home.pillar2_body: We publish our approach openly and partner with researchers who study what actually works in digital mental health support.
s.home.pillar3_body: The free tier never expires and never compromises on quality. Everyone deserves access regardless of income or location.
s.home.partners_title: Working with people who share our values
s.home.partners_body: Kounselia is a {strong} as much as a platform. We are actively building relationships with foundations, health organisations, and impact investors who believe mental health access is a fundamental right.
s.home.contact_p: If you represent a foundation, research institution, or public health body and would like to explore what we are building, we would love to hear from you.

s.pro.join_desc: Join Kounselia as a licensed mental health professional. Set your own rate, meet clients by video, and get paid securely.
s.pro.join_h1_em: closer to the people who need it
s.pro.join_sub: Kounselia helps people take the first step with our AI counselors — and when they're ready for a licensed human, they find you.
s.pro.b1_d: Members who have already started talking about what they carry come to you when they want a professional — no cold marketing.
s.pro.b2_d: Charge what your time is worth. Clients abroad pay in dollars; you are always paid in naira, straight to your bank.
s.pro.b3_d: Private video sessions, a message thread per booking, reminders for both of you, and weekly recurring bookings.
s.pro.b4_d: Open the times that suit you. Clients book and pay upfront, so no chasing invoices.
s.pro.b5_d: Clients rate sessions. Good reviews move you up the directory — anonymously, so your clients stay private.
s.pro.b6_d: Crisis language in messages is flagged to our safety team, so no one falls through the cracks.
s.pro.step1_d: Tell us about your training and upload your licence or registration. It takes about ten minutes.
s.pro.step2_d: Our team checks your credentials with the issuing body. We'll email you with a decision.
s.pro.step3_d: Add your bio, specialties and rate, open your availability, and add your payout account.
s.pro.step4_d: Members find you in the app and on the public directory, book a time, and pay upfront.
s.pro.faq1_a: Nothing to join. Kounselia keeps {commission}% of each session fee to run the platform; the rest is yours, paid in naira.
s.pro.faq2_a: Licensed or registered mental health professionals — psychologists, counsellors, psychotherapists, psychiatrists and clinical social workers — with credentials we can verify.
s.pro.faq3_q: Can I stay off the public website?
s.pro.faq3_a: Yes. You can hide your public profile at any time; signed-in members can still find and book you in the app.

c.fallback.serena.greeting:
Hello. I am really glad you are here.

This is your space. There is no agenda, no clock, and nothing you say here will be judged. Whatever you have been carrying, you do not have to carry it alone right now.

Take your time. When you are ready, what has been sitting with you lately?
c.fallback.marcus.greeting:
Good to have you here. I am Marcus.

I work with people who are at crossroads. Careers that no longer fit, purposes they cannot locate, next steps that feel both necessary and terrifying.

Let us get into it. What is the career or purpose question taking up the most space in your head right now?
c.fallback.noa.greeting:
Hey. I am Noa and I am genuinely glad you are here.

I work with people who are in the middle of becoming. Sometimes that looks like reinvention. Sometimes it is understanding why certain patterns keep repeating. Sometimes it is just a quiet feeling that the current version of you is not the whole story.

So tell me. Who are you right now and who do you think you are becoming?
c.fallback.eli.greeting:
Hi, I am Eli. Welcome.

Relationships are where most of our deepest joy and most of our real pain come from. They are also where we are most likely to repeat patterns we have not fully understood yet.

I am here to help you see those patterns more clearly.

What is the relationship situation you have been turning over in your mind?
c.fallback.dr_lena.greeting:
Hello. I am Dr. Lena and I am glad you are here.

I want to be clear from the start. This space moves at your pace, entirely. There is nothing you are required to share and no sequence you have to follow.

Trauma is not a character flaw. It is what happens when something genuinely overwhelming meets a person who was doing their best. My role is simply to be alongside you as you begin to understand it.

Where would you like to start today?
c.fallback.james.greeting:
Hey. I am James.

A lot of men who end up here took a while to click that button. There is something that tells us we should handle things on our own. That talking about it makes it more real or makes us look weak.

None of that is true. And none of it applies here.

This is just a conversation. No performance required. What is going on?
c.fallback.theo.greeting:
Hello. I am Theo.

Grief is one of the most isolating experiences a person can have. Partly because the world often expects us to move through it faster than we are able to. Partly because the people around us sometimes do not know how to hold it with us.

I am not in a hurry. There is no timeline here.

Would you like to tell me about who or what you have lost?
c.fallback.priya.greeting:
Hi, I am Priya. I am glad you are here, even if getting here took more energy than you felt you had.

Burnout tends to hit the people who cared the most, worked the hardest, and gave the most of themselves. It is not a sign of weakness. It is a sign that something has been out of balance for a long time.

Tell me. What does your exhaustion actually feel like right now?
